runtime_change: Parse explicit FLOAT/DOUBLE strings at target precision using the existing lexical dependency with Java suffix/hex grammar and ASCII 0-32 trimming. Preserve strict literal error folding and query-local modes. Backport upstream mixed-base guards and fix zero/subnormal hexadecimal rounding.

input_encoding.reason: Backslash-escaped quote reaches the float parser; doubled-quote SQL token discrepancy remains owned by issue 137.

sql_literal_quotes.scope: Confirmed existing SQL literal token handling; floating parser consumes backslash-escaped quote in the main corpus. Six lexical differences remain open.

regression.comparison_limit: Historical Decimal-text and coarse-stage comparison; schema and exact error parameters remain separate.

performance.status: Bounded compatibility cost check; final acceptance remains open.
